title: Aromatic Light Jamaican Macaroni Pasta
description: A savory and light Jamaican dish featuring macaroni, perfect for meal prep, made with ferment-jang for added flavor and served in an agave leaf vessel for a unique touch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet pepper and cook for another minute.
Stir in the ferment-jang, thyme, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Combine the cooked macaroni and the skillet mixture, tossing to combine.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to an agave leaf vessel and serve hot.
